run_mrp_main: run mrp.main() to start all defined processes in the setup file
define_conda_process: define a named process using mrp.Conda with a yaml env file and run command
define_docker_process: define a named process using mrp.Docker with a container image
setup_multi_process: setup multiple named processes combining Conda and Docker runtimes in one file
configure_conda_runtime: configure a Conda runtime specifying an env.yml file and python run command
